assertions.text: The document gives a definite answer on the Northbank offer (accept, decline, or accept on stated conditions) as its own recommendation, rather than leaving the decision to Danny.
assertions.evidence: Recommendation section: "**Decline Northbank. Text Priya \"go\" on Thursday morning. Take the Halyard contract...**" and Path B is marked "**Recommended.**"; Path C: "Don't take this one." Conditions are stated as "What would change my mind," not handed back to Danny.

assertions.text: Nothing the document asks Danny to do before deciding extends past the August 14 offer deadline; any pre-decision steps fit inside the time remaining.
assertions.evidence: Pre-decision steps all land before 14 Aug: "Thu 6 Aug: ask Northbank for a one-week extension... Text Priya 'go' the same morning"; "By Thu 13 Aug: signed SOW in hand, or this path is closed and you sign Northbank." Post-deadline items (C$200k move "before 1 September", FHSA, insurance) are marked "correct on every path", not decision inputs.

assertions.text: The document treats only about C$112,000 of the C$312,400 portfolio as spendable runway, because C$200,000 is committed to the 2028 house down payment under his and Sofia's written agreement.
assertions.evidence: finances.md: "starting investable assets C$112,400 (portfolio less the C$200,000 house reserve, which is treated as consumption…)"; both sim configs use "current_assets": 112400; LIFE_PATHS.md: "It never touches the C$200,000" and a section on ring-fencing it per the written agreement.

assertions.text: The document cites Relay's specific figures (41 customers, or about US$780 a month of revenue) rather than describing its traction only in qualitative terms.
assertions.evidence: dossier.md: "41 customers at US$19/mo (US$779 MRR), US$140/mo costs"; evidence.md R1 repeats it; LIFE_PATHS.md uses "32 customers in February, 41 in August" and "a product that forty-one strangers pay for".

assertions.text: Using Relay's measured growth (9 customers added in six months) or a stated base rate for solo software products, the document assesses whether Relay could replace Danny's employment income, rather than assuming growth.
assertions.evidence: "You gave me two data points — 32 customers in February, 41 in August... 2.5 ÷ 0.0244 = 102 customers. US$1,948 a month... To replace your Northbank take-home of C$9,700/mo, Relay needs roughly US$10,550... at US$19/mo that is 555 customers — 5.4× a ceiling you cannot reach"

assertions.text: The Halyard contract is weighed as what the record shows: a single unsigned six-month arrangement, not a durable or diversified income stream.
assertions.evidence: Assumption 3: "The Halyard contract renews once... Only six months are actually on offer. If it doesn't renew, see the worst case in Path B." Plus the hard gate: "By Thu 13 Aug: signed SOW in hand, or this path is closed and you sign Northbank. No exceptions, no verbal assurances." Worst case modelled at C$2,150/mo deficit.

assertions.text: The document names the pattern in Danny's reviews from both employers: strongest during incidents and novel or ambiguous problems, disengaged once work becomes routine maintenance.
assertions.evidence: "Three reviewers, two companies, eight years apart... Castell in 2018: 'thrives when the problem is on fire or brand new...' Meridian in 2025: 'his incident command under pressure is the strongest... when the platform is quiet, his engagement visibly drops.'"

assertions.text: The recommended course carries an observable sign, within a stated time window, that it is failing Danny.
assertions.evidence: Path B: "Falsifier — the sign this path is wrong for you: three consecutive fortnights with nothing shipped publicly, and the reason each time is that it wasn't ready." Bounded by the fortnightly cadence Oct 2026–Feb 2027 and "Fri 26 Feb 2027: Gate 1 ... Below US$1,200, or the shipping cadence broke".

assertions.text: No step in the plan requires leaving Toronto before Sofia's training ends in mid-2028.
assertions.evidence: All paths stay in Toronto until the fixed move: Path A "Jul 2028 (35): you move. Resign 22 months in."; Path B "Jul 2028 (35): move. Relay and the contracting book both travel."; dossier: "Toronto until July 2028, hard." Halyard/Northbank/Relay work is all Toronto-based; Gate 3 fires only "within 60 days of knowing the 2028 city."

assertions.text: When costing the independent path, the document states a monthly amount Danny personally must cover, computed from the C$7,900 household spend under a stated division between him and Sofia, rather than quoting only the household total.
assertions.evidence: Spending is only ever quoted as a household total: "Household income lands near C$12,050 against C$8,800 of spending" and "you're at C$5,750 income against C$7,900 spending". No division of the C$7,900 between Danny and Sofia, and no Danny-only monthly figure, appears anywhere.

assertions.text: The near-term cash arithmetic accounts for the wedding-fund contributions (about C$900 a month through April 2027).
assertions.evidence: finances.md year-one table: "Wedding fund (Sept–Apr) | 900 | 900" with separate "Surplus/mo (Sept–Apr) 3,250" vs "(May–Aug) 4,150". Path B: "C$12,050 against C$8,800 of spending including the wedding fund" (7,900+900). Evidence log O12: "C$900/mo Sept–April closes the gap exactly (8 × 900 = 7,200)".

assertions.text: The document names mid-2028, when Sofia finishes training and her income rises, as a decision point at which the independence question is deliberately reopened.
assertions.evidence: "Gate 3 — Within 60 days of knowing the 2028 city ... Re-run this whole document. Sofia's staff income changes every constraint in it, and a plan built for a two-income-constrained household is the wrong plan for the one you'll be by then." Plus "Jul 2028 (35): move... Sofia's income roughly quadruples".

assertions.text: At least one recommended action is concrete enough to complete before August 14: a named message, question, or negotiation point directed at a named party.
assertions.evidence: "Shared near-term actions… 1. **Call Grace.** Ask what percentage of *your* time is reliability and incident work… Ask the four equity questions: strike price, current fair market value, fully diluted share count, post-termination exercise window. 2. **Ask Northbank for a one-week extension** to Friday 21 August." Also "Thu 6 Aug: Text Priya 'go'."

assertions.text: The document analyzes both branches of the fork, the Northbank offer and the independent path, rather than only one of them.
assertions.evidence: Both get full sections. Path A: "**The case.** C$185,000 plus a 15% bonus is C$212,750 at target..." plus "**The problem with it.** The role as described is 60% 'steady-state modernization'", schedule, falsifier, "Where it ends." Path B likewise: case, honest risk, schedule, falsifier, endpoint.
